notes.title: Walkthrough, Now Available!
notes.content:
Need help?  A full walkthrough for Seek Not a Lighthouse is now available at
https://www.midnightcoffeeinc.com/seek-not-a-lighthouse-walkthrough.html

notes.title: Walkthrough Contest!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Since launch there has been a walkthrough contest, wherein the first three players to write (or record) a full walkthrough of Seek Not a Lighthouse will get a free copy!

Unfortunately the prize has yet to be claimed!
So, watch out for that and remember: All you have to do is write a walkthrough! 

Thanks!
Judah Mantell,
MidnightCoffee, Inc.
